After a complete failed approximate calibration, union only observed valid-prefix calibration nonlinear inputs with the original native/exact ranges, then reapply the same whole-site rule/ladder. A rejected input may be recorded as an observation without evaluating its invalid operator. Preserve all stopped suffixes; output errors cannot fit coefficients.
selection.coefficient_algorithm: Pinned numeric.coefficients inverse_sqrt interpolation and32*binary64epsilon pruning. Actual stored coefficients and rounded affine map enter the certificate.
selection.uniform_certificate: Exact rational H(t)=((t-B)/A)*P(t)^2-1; endpoint extent M and monotone Chebyshev envelope ||H||1*Tdeg(H)(M). Require delta<1, mapped interval contains0, P(0)>0, and delta/(2-delta)<=1e-6.
selection.binary64_diagnostic: Deduplicated2049 linear +2049 geometric points and actual endpoints, evaluated by unchanged explicit balanced circuit; require finite values and maxrelative<=1e-6. Compare independent Clenshaw diagnostically. These sampled checks do not prove floating/CKKS accuracy.
selection.fallback: Smallest static Newton count <=64 with exact rounded initial-affine residual certificate and same1e-6 relative bound, plus fixed2049 linear/geometric binary64 grids. This must be regenerated from each new public interval; do not reuse old counts for new endpoints. Unsupported certificate/overflow/instability fails the whole candidate.
selection.protected_rule_checks: Observe all protected SiLU/softmax domains in all3200 trajectories and independently recompute conditional public SiLU radii from new norm relative certificates and pinned learned gate/gamma bounds. Any protected-domain/radius failure marks candidate unsupported; no automatic protected-rule retuning.
selection.freeze: Freeze all113 rules/full candidate/provenance before any approximate calibration. Freeze the first fully calibration-passing candidate before any new validation or row0 measurement.
